requirements.evidence: Core contract is present and correct: migration columns/unique/chain (database/migrations/2026_08_13_000000_create_entity_invites_table.php:15-25), lowercase/trim normalizer (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:34-39), sendInvite with validation, duplicate-member/pending checks, race-safe QueryException handling, audit log and reset (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:49-129), cancelInvite (131-144), accept/decline with 403, expiry error on 'invite', idempotent re-accept, firstOrCreate, session + redirect (app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:14-68), switcher/onboarding inclusion with an <hr> only when invites exist (resources/views/livewire/entity/pending-invites.blade.php:2-16), mailable/markdown/subject (app/Mail/EntityInviteMail.php:20-35) and lang keys. Missing requirement: the members page title "Members of :entity" / "Membros de :entity" is never rendered (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:8 shows only the invite-section title); lang/pt_BR.json:866 adds the key but it is unused. Also the expired-invite error on key 'invite' (PendingInvites.php:29) is never displayed.

conventions.evidence: No #[Validate] attributes on the public input properties and no #[Locked] on the record-id property (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:28-34), whereas conventions.md requires '#[Validate] + $this->validate()' and '#[Locked]' for record IDs. Custom 'can:update,entity' route middleware is added (routes/web.php:57) without registering it as persistent middleware, so update requests rely only on in-component checks. Error strings are untranslated literals (Members.php:65,78,111) and only one is added to lang/pt_BR.json:877. No docs (docs/database-schema.md, docs/business-rules.md) or CHANGELOG.md updates for a new table and domain invariant. Migration style/fillable/down() and audit logging do follow the project (migration:13-35, EntityInvite.php:12).

security.evidence: Good: sendInvite/cancelInvite authorize('update') and resolve records through $this->entity scoped relations (Members.php:51,133,135); saveRole/removeMember authorize via policy (159,197); accept/decline enforce the invitee e-mail match with abort_if 403 (PendingInvites.php:18-21,56-59); all model args are resolved server-side and all output uses {{ }} (members.blade.php:36-40,83-85). Gap: openMember() resolves a membership and returns its data with no $this->authorize() (Members.php:146-153), and confirmRemoval()/cancelRemoval() are public endpoints without authorization (187-195), violating the Livewire policy rule 'authorize every action'; impact is limited because the page is gated at mount and the record is entity-scoped.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no test files at all (no tests/... entries in change.diff). conventions.md requires a Pest/PHPUnit test for every feature and specifically happy path, validation failure, unauthorized call and tamper test for each Livewire action; none exist for Members, PendingInvites, EntityInvite, the factory, the mail or the route guard.

simplicity.evidence: Mostly direct and lean: one component per concern, reuse of x-input/Bulma and the audit channel. Minor waste/duplication: a pending-invite scope is declared but never used (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:63-66) while the same filter is inlined twice (Members.php:228-232, PendingInvites.php:76-77); catch (QueryException) at Members.php:110 treats any database error as a duplicate invite.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and purpose-named, with comments for non-obvious rules (Members.php:61,70,93,161,168); style matches the existing component. Deductions: duplicated pending-invite query, hardcoded English messages at Members.php:65,78,111, and an unused ASSIGNABLE_ROLES constant left behind (Members.php:41).

scope.evidence: Every file and edit serves the invite feature: model/relation/factory/migration/mail/views/lang/components/route (change.diff file list). No unrelated refactors; the only extras are small unused helpers on EntityInvite (isExpired/isPending/inviter, app/Models/EntityInvite.php:46-61) and an unused 'Members' JSON entry (lang/pt_BR.json:871), which are noted elsewhere.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests even though conventions.md mandates TDD and requires happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests for every Livewire action, so the suite cannot demonstrate any of the new behavior.

openMember() resolves a membership and exposes its user data without calling $this->authorize(), breaking the Livewire rule that every public action authorizes the resolved model; confirmRemoval()/cancelRemoval() (187-195) are likewise unauthenticated public endpoints.
The required page title "Members of :entity" / "Membros de :entity" is missing (only the invite-section title is rendered), and the translation added at lang/pt_BR.json:866 is unused.
accept() adds an error on key 'invite' for expired invites (PendingInvites.php:29), but the view never renders @error('invite'), so the user sees nothing when an invite has expired.

Public input properties use inline rule arrays instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern, and the client-writable $selectedMembershipId is not marked #[Locked] as required for record-id properties.

The new 'can:update,entity' route middleware is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it does not re-apply on Livewire update requests and the page-level gate depends entirely on in-component authorization.

Error messages are raw English strings passed to __() rather than keys, and only "This invitation has expired." was added to lang/pt_BR.json (877), leaving the two invite-conflict messages untranslated.
A new table and the invite/acceptance domain invariant are introduced without the docs and CHANGELOG updates that conventions.md requires in the same change.
scopePending() is never used while Members.php:228-232 and PendingInvites.php:76-77 inline the same pending filter, so either the scope should be used or removed.

catch (QueryException) converts every database failure into the duplicate-invite error on inviteEmail, masking unrelated failures instead of checking the unique index violation (e.g. error code 23000).
inviter(), isExpired() and isPending() are added but unused anywhere in the change (accept/decline check expires_at/isPast inline), which is speculative code rather than something the task needs.

review.summary: The change implements the invite flow end to end (table/model/factory/mail/markdown/locales, manager-only members page with invite/pending lists and detail/removal modals, PendingInvites accept/decline, and the switcher/onboarding integration) with good scoping and mostly correct edge cases. It cannot be merged as is because it ships no tests at all, three public Livewire actions (openMember, confirmRemoval, cancelRemoval) skip server-side authorization, and the required members page title is missing, with several smaller convention gaps (no #[Validate]/#[Locked], non-persistent route middleware, untranslated strings, missing docs/CHANGELOG).
